decisions.reason: It builds on the core offer, appears inexpensive to carry, and the documented annual customer savings suggest the option is proving valuable rather than resolving negatively.
As a close-to-core machine still given its own page after two years, it remains a reasonable option to keep even without explicit public performance evidence.
The named customer adoption and quantified savings in 2024 indicate positive market validation, so the product’s upside is being realized and does not justify withdrawal.
This is a very recent launch in the firm’s established shredder area, so uncertainty is still unresolved and the cost of keeping the option open is likely low.

Although newer and somewhat more exploratory than the close-to-core launches, it still builds on existing screening capabilities and a growing firm in a favorable market is likely to give it more time.
